X(n,dd) := dd·round(R53(n/dd)·2^32) == n·2^32 (the fixed kernel's R8 law; X ⟺ dd dyadic given gcd=1 — the T2 theorem). class := E∧X→D | E∧¬X→A | ¬E∧X→F-INV | ¬E∧same-sign→B | else C.
